title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Luke 20: the question about authority, the parable of the vineyard, the denarius, the Sadducees and the warning about the scribes.

questions.text: Who came to Jesus in the temple and asked by what authority he was acting?
questions.explanation: While he was teaching in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

answers.text: The priests and scribes, with the elders
The Roman governor and his soldiers
A crowd of Galilean fishermen
Two of his own disciples

questions.text: What question did Jesus ask them in return?
questions.explanation: He said he would ask them one question: whether the baptism of John was from heaven or from men.

answers.text: Whether it was lawful to heal on the Sabbath
Who had built the temple they stood in
Whether the baptism of John was from heaven or from men
How many prophets they had believed

questions.text: What did they fear would happen if they answered that John's baptism was from men?
questions.explanation: They reasoned that if they said "From men", all the people would stone them, because the people were persuaded that John was a prophet.

answers.text: The governor would have them arrested
All the people would stone them
Jesus would refuse to teach again
They would lose their seats in the temple

questions.text: In the parable, what did the farmers do to the first servant the owner sent?
questions.explanation: The owner sent a servant to collect his share of the fruit, but the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

answers.text: They gladly gave him the fruit
They killed him and buried him in the vineyard
They sent him back with a gift for the owner
They beat him and sent him away empty

questions.text: Whom did the lord of the vineyard send after the three servants?
questions.explanation: The lord of the vineyard said he would send his beloved son, hoping that they would respect him.

answers.text: His beloved son
A fourth servant
A company of soldiers
His neighbour from another country

questions.text: How did the hearers react when Jesus said the owner would destroy those farmers?
questions.explanation: Jesus said the lord of the vineyard would destroy the farmers and give the vineyard to others, and when they heard it they said, "May that never be!"

answers.text: They praised him with a loud shout
They asked him to tell the parable again
They quietly got up and left
They said, "May that never be!"

questions.text: Whose image and inscription did they say were on the denarius?
questions.explanation: Jesus asked them to show him a denarius and whose image and inscription were on it, and they answered, "Caesar's."

answers.text: Moses'
David's
Caesar's
The governor's

questions.text: What did the Sadducees who came to him deny?
questions.explanation: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

answers.text: That Moses wrote the law
That there is a resurrection
That the temple would be destroyed
That taxes should be paid to Caesar

questions.text: What did Jesus say those who attain to that age are like?
questions.explanation: He said they can no longer die, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

answers.text: Like little children
Like the prophets of old
Like Moses at the bush
Like the angels

questions.text: What did Jesus say the scribes do to widows' houses?
questions.explanation: He warned his disciples about the scribes who devour widows' houses and for a pretense make long prayers.

answers.text: They devour them
They rebuild them
They buy them at a fair price
They pray in them every morning
